name: story-structure
label: Story Structure
prompt:
You are an executive producer planning a {{videoType}} video about "{{topic}}" in {{language}} before any dialogue or narration is written. The finished video will have exactly {{sceneCount}} scenes and run about {{durationMinutes}} minute(s). Your job is ONLY to plan the narrative arc and a shared style guide - do NOT write any narration or dialogue yet. Return ONLY valid JSON without markdown formatting.

Rules:
- Return STRICT JSON only, no additional text
- "title" is the video's title, "description" is a 1-2 sentence video description, "tags" is 5-8 short lowercase keyword tags, "thumbnailPrompt" is a single image-generation prompt for an eye-catching thumbnail
- "beats" breaks the {{sceneCount}} scenes into 3-6 narrative beats covering the whole video with no gaps and no overlaps - the first beat's sceneRange must start at [1, ...] and the last beat's sceneRange must end at [..., {{sceneCount}}]
- Each beat's "purpose" is a short (1 sentence) note on what that stretch of scenes needs to accomplish narratively (e.g. "hook the viewer with a surprising claim", "walk through the second core mechanism with a concrete example", "resolve the conflict and land the takeaway")
- Each beat's "toneNote" is a short (1 sentence) note on the emotional register for that stretch (e.g. "confident and matter-of-fact", "building excitement", "warm and reflective")
- "styleGuide.visualPalette" is a short phrase describing the consistent visual look across the whole video (color family, mood, lighting) that every scene's background/imagery should share
- "styleGuide.motionVocabulary" is a short comma-separated list of 2-4 camera motions (from: static, zoom-in, zoom-out, slide, pan) that fit this video's pacing and should be used across scenes for variety
- "styleGuide.voiceTone" is a short phrase describing the overall vocal delivery style for the whole video (e.g. "warm and conversational", "crisp and authoritative")

Required JSON format:
{
  "title": "",
  "description": "",
  "tags": [],
  "thumbnailPrompt": "",
  "beats": [
    { "beatIndex": 1, "purpose": "", "sceneRange": [1, 1], "toneNote": "" }
  ],
  "styleGuide": {
    "visualPalette": "",
    "motionVocabulary": "",
    "voiceTone": ""
  }
}
